title: Wannabe Gangster Gets Caught With AK-47 After Acting Tough With Police
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On November 20, 2022. Officers were dispatched to a hotel in reference to a man who was going around the hotel knocking on people’s doors and doing other various things. The hotel manager wanted him criminally trespassed from the property. When the officers asked the man to gather his belongings, he started to act irrationally and refusing to listen, he was eventually pepper sprayed and arrested. Officers conducted a search on the man’s room and found an AK-47 laying on the bed. This is footage of the events that followed.

*We are aware that Texas is an open carry state, however it does raise the question as to why the suspect had a deadly automatic weapon in a hotel*
